text: dsh-git-chain 是一款面向 DSH 网页客户端的 Git 提交图插件，在侧边栏或备用浮动面板中呈现仓库提交历史。它通过 Host 端 Git 服务读取工作区状态和提交记录，并以 SVG 泳道展示分支与合并关系。用户可以按全部引用、当前分支或指定本地分支查看历史，筛选已加载的提交，打开提交详情和差异，并在界面中切换分支。适合需要在 DSH 工作流里浏览仓库历史的开发者；使用时需要 DSH、Node.js 和系统 Git。

dsh-git-chain adds a Git history panel to DSH web, showing branches and merges as an SVG graph. Browse all refs or a branch, filter loaded commits, inspect commit details and diffs, and switch the workspace branch. Requires DSH, Node.js, and Git.
想在 DSH 里直观看清 Git 分支和合并形成的提交关系。
有没有办法在网页界面浏览仓库的提交历史？
我想按当前分支或某个本地分支过滤提交图。
能不能点开一个提交查看改了哪些文件和具体差异？
希望在 DSH 中搜索已加载提交的作者、主题或哈希。
让 DSH 显示 Git 泳道图，并支持只看主线。
I want to explore branch and merge history as a graph inside DSH.
Can I inspect a commit and view its changed files and diff in the web UI?
dsh-git-chain 的功能「Git 历史图」：在面板中绘制提交泳道与分支关系，可查看全部 refs、当前分支或指定本地分支，并切换 first-parent 主线视图。
dsh-git-chain 的功能「提交检索与详情」：用户可过滤已加载提交的主题、作者、引用或哈希；选择提交后查看提交信息、变更文件及按需加载的 unified diff。
dsh-git-chain 的功能「工作区分支切换」：用户从面板的分支菜单选择本地分支，Host 执行 Git 切换并返回结果，成功后刷新图表。
dsh-git-chain 的功能「Git 状态刷新」：面板请求工作区状态、分支和提交图，并可手动刷新或接收 SSE 变化通知后更新显示。
dsh-git-chain 使用前须知：切换分支会在对应 DSH workspace 的仓库中执行 Git 切换，改变该工作区当前检出的分支。

面向 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) 的 Git 提交图插件。它把仓库历史呈现为可读的 SVG 泳道图，并在同一个侧边栏工作流中提供提交详情、完整 Diff、范围过滤和受保护的本地分支切换。

> 当前版本：`0.1.1` · Stable · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/ShinonomeAya/dsh-git-chain/releases/tag/v0.1.1) · MIT License

dsh-git-chain README · 为什么使用 dsh-git-chain：- **看清提交拓扑**：用连续泳道、节点、merge 汇入线和分支出线表达真实的 Git DAG。
- **保持工作流连贯**：优先显示在 `dsh-better-sidebar` 中；没有该基座时回退为输入栏芯片和浮动面板。
- **从查看到定位**：点击提交即可查看作者、父提交、变更文件和懒加载的 unified Diff。
- **安全地切换分支**：切换前检查冲突、进行中的 Git 操作、其他 worktree 和可能被覆盖的文件。
- **适配不同阅读方式**：支持全部 refs、当前分支、指定本地分支和 first-parent 主线；支持中文/英文界面。

当前版本是 `0.1.1` Stable；已在 Windows 11 + DSH Desktop `2.0.2.0` 的固定 profile 完成安装、升级、卸载、重装和 fallback 验收。其他 DSH/OS 组合请先参考兼容性矩阵。
dsh-git-chain README · 界面预览：完整链路展示分支泳道、merge 节点、当前分支和 refs；“仅主线”聚焦当前 `HEAD` 的第一父链。

dsh-git-chain README · Git 历史与过滤：- 使用 Git CLI 获取带父关系和 decorations 的拓扑排序历史。
- 查看全部 refs、当前分支或指定本地分支的服务端范围。
- 使用 first-parent 查看当前 `HEAD` 的主线视图，同时保留 merge 元数据。
- 在已加载的历史窗口内按主题、作者、引用或 commit OID 即时过滤。
- 固定行高、虚拟滚动和可识别的 lane identity，适合较长的提交列表。

dsh-git-chain README · 提交详情与 Diff：- 展示作者、提交者、时间、父提交和变更文件。
- 用文件状态徽标和增删行数快速定位变化。
- 按需加载 unified Diff；Host 对单次输出设置 1 MB 上限，避免大变更占满界面。

dsh-git-chain README · 分支切换与刷新：- 列出当前工作区的本地分支，并同步当前分支勾选状态。
- 使用 `git switch --no-guess`，不会隐式创建或猜测远端分支。
- Host 通过 SSE 推送外部 Git 变化，窗口重新聚焦时也会节流刷新。

dsh-git-chain README · 从源码安装到 DSH：环境要求：

- DSH `>= 0.1.1-rc.1`
- Node.js `>= 22.19.0`
- Git，且已加入系统 `PATH`

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ShinonomeAya/dsh-git-chain.git
cd dsh-git-chain
pnpm install
pnpm run build

重新启动 DSH，使 Host 侧插件和 bundle patch 生效，然后打开侧边栏中的 **Git 链路图**。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-git-chain
```

Windows PowerShell 示例：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:F:\path\to\dsh-git-chain
```

将上面的路径替换为你的本地 checkout 路径。

dsh-git-chain README · 技术架构：```text
DSH Web GUI                         DSH Host
┌──────────────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ better-sidebar tab       │ HTTP  │ workspace-gated Git service │
│ 或 fallback 浮动面板      │ ────► │ /git-chain/* JSON + SSE      │

dsh-git-chain README · 技术架构：- **Host**：通过 `ctx.subprocess` 调用 Git CLI，提供 workspace、status、branches、graph、show、diff 和受守卫的 switch 能力。
- **Client**：React 面板负责 SVG 泳道、节点交互、虚拟滚动、过滤和详情联动。
- **布局**：纯函数布局快照携带 lane identity、节点类型、merge edge、窗口边界和节点入边语义，避免线路断开或因列变化错色。
- **构建**：`tsdown` 分别输出 Host bundle 和浏览器 Client bundle，符合 DSH 的双面 Cordis 插件装配方式。

dsh-git-chain README · 安全边界：- Git 路由只接受 DSH 已注册 workspace，并进行真实路径校验。
- 默认只接受 loopback 请求；配对设备放行仍需额外信任凭据。
- 变更接口要求 `application/json`。
- 分支名和 commit OID 在进入 Git 命令前经过白名单校验；命令使用 argv，不拼接 shell 字符串。
- 分支切换遇到冲突、进行中的操作、其他 worktree 或文件覆盖风险时会拒绝执行。

dsh-git-chain README · 已知限制：- 文本过滤目前只作用于已加载窗口；subject、author、文件级的全历史服务端搜索仍在路线图中。
- 图布局采用最小泳道策略，少数复杂菱形 merge 可能出现轻微曲线重叠。
- 虚拟滚动窗口上下缘会对泳道进行截断，并通过 overscan 减少视觉跳变。
- 单次完整 Diff 输出上限为 1 MB。

dsh-git-chain README · 路线图与反馈：后续计划包括父链 hover 高亮、键盘导航、提交比较、服务端全文查询、分页和增量更新。详细的同类项目调研、架构取舍和分阶段计划见 [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md)。

dsh-git-chain README · dsh-git-chain：**English · [中文](README.md)**

A Git commit graph plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness). It renders repository history as a readable SVG lane graph and brings commit details, full diffs, scoped history, filtering, and guarded local branch switching into the same sidebar workflow.

> Current version: `0.1.1` · Stable · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/ShinonomeAya/dsh-git-chain/releases/tag/v0.1.1) · MIT License

dsh-git-chain README · Why dsh-git-chain：- **See topology clearly**: continuous lanes, nodes, merge joins, and branch edges represent the Git DAG instead of text glyphs.
- **Stay in one workflow**: mounts as a `dsh-better-sidebar` tab when available, with an input-chip and floating-panel fallback.
- **Move from history to evidence**: inspect authors, parents, changed files, and a lazy-loaded unified diff from any commit.
- **Switch branches safely**: checks conflicts, in-progress Git operations, other worktrees, and files that could be overwritten before switching.
- **Choose the right scope**: browse all refs, the current branch, an exact local branch, or the current `HEAD`'s first-parent history; the UI supports Chinese and English.

dsh-git-chain README · Why dsh-git-chain：This is `0.1.1` Stable. Installation, upgrade, uninstall, reinstall, and fallback acceptance passed on Windows 11 with DSH Desktop `2.0.2.0`; see the compatibility matrix before using another DSH/OS combination.
dsh-git-chain README · Screenshots：The full graph shows branch lanes, merge nodes, the current branch, and refs. First-parent mode focuses on the mainline of the current `HEAD`.

dsh-git-chain README · Git history and filtering：- Reads Git history with parent relationships and decorations in topological order.
- Provides server-side scopes for all refs, the current branch, and an exact local branch.
- Provides first-parent mode for the current `HEAD` while retaining merge metadata.
- Filters the loaded history window instantly by subject, author, ref, or commit OID.
- Uses fixed row heights, virtual scrolling, and stable lane identities for long commit lists.

dsh-git-chain README · Commit details and diffs：- Shows author, committer, timestamps, parents, and changed files.
- Uses file-status badges and insertion/deletion counts to make changes easy to scan.
- Loads unified diffs on demand; the Host caps each response at 1 MB to keep large changes from taking over the UI.

dsh-git-chain README · Branch switching and refresh：- Lists local branches and keeps the current-branch checkmark in sync.
- Uses `git switch --no-guess` and never implicitly creates or guesses a remote branch.
- The Host publishes external Git changes over SSE and throttles refreshes when the window regains focus.

dsh-git-chain README · Install from source into DSH：Requirements:

- DSH `>= 0.1.1-rc.1`
- Node.js `>= 22.19.0`
- Git available on the system `PATH`

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ShinonomeAya/dsh-git-chain.git
cd dsh-git-chain
pnpm install
pnpm run build

Restart DSH so the Host-side plugin and bundle patch take effect, then open **Git Chain** from the sidebar.

Remove it with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-git-chain
```

dsh-git-chain README · Architecture：```text
DSH Web GUI                         DSH Host
┌──────────────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ better-sidebar tab       │ HTTP  │ workspace-gated Git service │
│ or fallback panel        │ ────► │ /git-chain/* JSON + SSE     │

dsh-git-chain README · Architecture：- **Host**: invokes Git through `ctx.subprocess` and exposes workspace, status, branches, graph, show, diff, and guarded switch operations.
- **Client**: React renders the SVG lanes, node interactions, virtual list, filtering, and detail view.
- **Layout**: a pure layout snapshot carries lane identity, node types, merge edges, window boundaries, and node-entry semantics so lines stay connected and colors remain stable when columns move.
- **Build**: `tsdown` produces separate Host and browser Client bundles in the dual-face Cordis format expected by DSH.

dsh-git-chain README · Security boundaries：- Git routes accept only registered DSH workspaces and validate their canonical paths.
- Requests are loopback-only by default; paired-device access still requires an additional trust credential.
- Mutation routes require `application/json`.
- Branch names and commit OIDs are allowlisted before reaching Git; commands use argv instead of shell-string concatenation.
- Branch switches are rejected when conflicts, in-progress operations, another worktree, or overwrite risks are detected.

dsh-git-chain README · Known limitations：- Text filtering currently applies only to the loaded window; full-history server-side search by subject, author, or file is planned.
- The layout uses a minimal-lane strategy, so rare complex diamond merges can have slight curve overlap.
- Virtualized windows clip lane edges at their boundaries; overscan reduces visible jumps.
- A full diff response is capped at 1 MB.

dsh-git-chain README · Roadmap and feedback：Planned work includes parent-chain hover highlighting, keyboard navigation, commit comparison, full-history server queries, pagination, and incremental updates. See [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md) for the research, architecture decisions, and phased plan.
